# TheTravel

> > TheTravel is a travel news and destination guide covering North American tourism trends, national parks, border issues, and transportation controversies.

TheTravel provides timely coverage of travel disruptions, tourist behavior controversies, and emerging destination trends across the United States and Canada. The site focuses on practical travel news, national park updates, cross-border travel issues, and alternative destinations for savvy travelers.

## Key Topics

- US-Canada border tensions
- National Park Service staffing and rules
- Amtrak service issues
- Ontario tourism
- Cross-border travel
- Tourist behavior controversies
- Alternative destinations
- National park regulations
- Transportation complaints
- Border checkpoints
- European tourists in North America
- Cruise line operations
- State parks vs national parks
- Travel boycotts
- Tourism trends

## US-Canada Border & Cross-Border Travel

- [Americans Sound The Alarm On Their Own Border After Canadians Get Asked A Question "For The First Time Since 1997"](https://www.thetravel.com/americans-sound-the-alarm-border-canadian-get-asked-a-question-for-the-first-time-since-1997): US border officers crack down on Canadian travelers with new questions
- [Travelers Shocked As Canadian Boycott Causes Major Change At The Border](https://www.thetravel.com/travelers-shocked-no-queues-border-crossing-canada-us): Canadian boycott creates empty queues at US-Canada border crossings
- [Canada Goes Elbows Down For Americans: US Tourists Have Stopped Visiting A Beloved Canadian Attraction](https://www.thetravel.com/canada-elbows-down-for-americans-tourists-that-stopped-visiting-niagara-falls): American tourists boycott Niagara Falls amid border tensions
- [American Airlines Applauded For Choosing Its Newest Canadian Destination Wisely Despite Boycotts](https://www.thetravel.com/american-airlines-chooses-its-newest-canadian-destination-wisely-despite-boycotts): American Airlines expands to Quebec City amid US-Canada travel boycotts
- [Canadians Rejoice As One Province Is Single-Handedly Snatching European Tourists From The United States](https://www.thetravel.com/ontario-canada-snatching-european-tourists-from-united-states): Ontario attracts German & European tourists via Air Canada routes
- [The U.S.-Canada Border Runs Right Through This Gorgeous National Park](https://www.thetravel.com/us-canada-border-through-waterton-lakes-glacier-national-park): Waterton-Glacier International Peace Park spans US-Canada border

## National Parks & Staffing Crisis

- [NPS Workers 'Pushed To Breaking Point' As Popular National Park Operates With Just Over Half Its Staff](https://www.thetravel.com/crater-lake-national-park-operates-with-just-over-half-its-staff): Crater Lake faces staffing crisis after Trump administration NPS layoffs
- [Grand Teton National Park Visitors Are Torn Over Rule-Breaker Caught Using Banned Device Right Next To Warning Sign](https://www.thetravel.com/tourist-flies-banned-drone-at-grand-teton-national-park-near-warning-sign): Tourist controversy over drone ban violation at Grand Teton's Mormon Row
- [Russia's Magnitude 8.8 Earthquake Caused An Eerie Disturbance 4,000 Miles Away In Death Valley National Park](https://www.thetravel.com/russia-earthquake-disturbs-devils-hole-pupfish-death-valley-national-park): Kamchatka earthquake impacts Devil's Hole pupfish in Death Valley

- [Wyoming's Most Underrated State Park Is Better Than Yellowstone National Park](https://www.thetravel.com/seminoe-state-park-is-better-than-yellowstone-national-park): Seminoe State Park offers uncrowded Wyoming alternative to Yellowstone
